summary: The customer wants an optical measurement system to monitor yeast fermentation growth and metabolism, and requests a feasibility study.

facts_stated.text: They want an optical measurement during yeast fermentation to follow growth and notice changes earlier.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We would like an optical measurement during yeast fermentation to help us follow growth and notice changes earlier.

facts_stated.text: A biomass signal and a metabolic signal have been mentioned but not defined as separate targets.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Our team has mentioned both a biomass signal and a metabolic signal, but these have not been defined as separate targets.

facts_stated.text: The broth becomes more optically dense as the run develops.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The broth becomes more optically dense as the run develops.

customer_premises.claim: An optical measurement can be applied directly to follow growth and detect changes early in this fermentation process.
